compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

The inbox [rebar:51ce-b03e-cff5-4e9c] reaches a session only when it next touches the tracker; an autonomous run that spends twenty minutes in `make verify` or a plan-review gate hears nothing meanwhile, and a session that never calls the tracker never learns of a notice [rebar:ac3a-9ea7-530d-48f4]. Every target harness exposes a hook that can add text to the model's context at a turn boundary — Claude Code `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, and `PostToolUse` (`additionalContext`; the harness discards plugin-defined `SessionStart` context, anthropics/claude-code#16538, so the wiring must be project-level), OpenCode `chat.message`, Cursor `sessionStart` (`additional_context`) — while Codex has no context-injecting hook (only fire-and-forget `notify`). Sessions tasked with monitoring alarms or debugging also need to know that alert announcements go only to subscribers, or they will never subscribe. This repository already ships per-harness shims under `scripts/session-shims/` (`docs/session-id-shims.md`), and its agent guidance lives in `AGENTS.md`, `docs/user-guide.md`, and the client `templates/`.

## Approach

- **One hook renderer in rebar**: `rebar inbox --hook claude-code|cursor|opencode` prints the harness's exact envelope only when the feed is non-empty — Claude Code: `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"<event>","additionalContext":"<lines>"}}` on stdout (for `SessionStart` the plain lines, which that event adds to context); Cursor: `{"additional_context":"<lines>"}`; OpenCode: the plain lines. The renderer reuses the inbox's own 60-second computation window, so a hook firing on every tool call costs one store read per minute at most, and it always exits 0 (a hook must never block a turn).
- **Shims** (thin, fire-and-forget, in `scripts/session-shims/`): extend `claude-code-session-start.sh` to also print the session-start feed (and fix its stale comment that `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` is remote-only); add `claude-code-inbox-hook.sh` for `UserPromptSubmit` and `PostToolUse` (matcher `Bash|mcp__rebar__.*`); add `opencode-rebar-inbox.js` (a `chat.message` plugin calling the renderer); add `cursor-hooks.json` (`sessionStart`); document the Codex gap and its piggyback-only behaviour. Wire the Claude Code hooks into the repository's `.claude/settings.json` (which already carries a project-level `PreToolUse` hook) so every session in this checkout gets them without a plugin.
- **Runbook + guidance**: new `docs/session-notifications.md` — what the inbox delivers on each seam, the per-harness wiring table with the degradation column (Codex: piggyback only; Cursor: session start only), how a monitoring or debugging session subscribes (`rebar inbox subscribe ops-alert`, MCP `subscribe_inbox`), how to post and cancel notices, and the identity model (principal + hint; principal-wide fallback). `AGENTS.md` gains three lines in the parallel-agent workflow section: sessions launched to monitor alarms/alerts or to debug operational failures subscribe first; notices are advisory and read via `rebar notice list`; the inbox is the holder-side companion of the cross-session warning. `docs/user-guide.md` gains the inbox and notice sections and retires the "run a sweep" instruction in favour of "read the ingest ledger; subscribe". `templates/AGENTS.md` and `templates/rebar-usage.md` (the client-facing guidance copies) receive the same three-line addition. `docs/session-id-shims.md` documents the new hooks alongside the identity shim.

Positive rationale: a single renderer inside rebar keeps every shim a one-line call, so harness-specific JSON lives in one tested place; project-level hook wiring is the only Claude Code path whose context injection is not silently dropped; the runbook is what turns "subscribed sessions only" from a mechanism into a practice.

Failure disposition: any hook error is swallowed (exit 0, empty output) — the feed is still delivered by piggyback on the next tracker call, so a broken hook degrades to today's behaviour, never blocks a session.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_commands/inbox.py` (`--hook` renderer), `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/reads.py`, `docs/cli-reference.md` (regen).
- `scripts/session-shims/claude-code-session-start.sh`, `scripts/session-shims/claude-code-inbox-hook.sh` (new), `scripts/session-shims/opencode-rebar-inbox.js` (new), `scripts/session-shims/cursor-hooks.json` (new), `.claude/settings.json`.
- `docs/session-notifications.md` (new), `docs/session-id-shims.md`, `docs/user-guide.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `templates/AGENTS.md`, `templates/rebar-usage.md`, `docs/README.md` (index entry).
- `tests/unit/test_inbox_hook_render.py` (new), `tests/scripts/test_session_shims.py` (extend).

## Testing

- Unit: the renderer emits the exact Claude Code envelope for `UserPromptSubmit`/`PostToolUse`, plain lines for `SessionStart`, the Cursor and OpenCode shapes, and **nothing** (empty stdout, exit 0) when the feed is empty (contrast); a rate-limited second call within the window emits nothing.
- Shell subprocess (the shim tier): each shim run with a fixture stdin envelope and a fake `rebar` on `PATH` exits 0 and forwards the renderer's output unchanged; with `rebar` absent it exits 0 with empty output (fail-safe, the existing shim test shape).
- Docs: the docs-drift and generated-CLI-reference gates pass; a grep test asserts `AGENTS.md`, both templates, and `docs/session-notifications.md` mention `rebar inbox subscribe ops-alert`. Gate: `make test`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `rebar inbox --hook claude-code` prints a valid `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` envelope when items exist and nothing with exit 0 when none exist; verified by `tests/unit/test_inbox_hook_render.py`.
- [ ] Each shim exits 0 and forwards the renderer output, and exits 0 silently when `rebar` is missing; verified by `tests/scripts/test_session_shims.py`.
- [ ] `.claude/settings.json` wires `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, and `PostToolUse` to the shims at project level; verified by a JSON assertion in `tests/scripts/test_session_shims.py`.
- [ ] `docs/session-notifications.md` exists with the per-harness wiring/degradation table and the subscribe, notice, and identity sections; `AGENTS.md`, `templates/AGENTS.md`, and `templates/rebar-usage.md` instruct monitoring/debugging sessions to subscribe; verified by the grep test and the docs-drift gate.
- [ ] [non-codebase] In a fresh Claude Code session in this checkout, posting a notice from a second session appears in the first session's next turn without any tracker call by the first session; the operator records the transcript excerpt and timestamp as a comment on this ticket.
